g.text: Each type of program against the systems native to it

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each instance counts in one type, whatever language its source was written in. A system’s answers are over all

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: of the type’s instances. On each row, the system’s total time and tddlog’s (teal) over the instances the system

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: is given and either answers, a run that does not answer (out of time or memory, failed, or a program the system

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: cannot express) counted as twice its time limit (PAR-2, as in the SAT and model counting competitions) and a

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: time under 0.2 s as 0.2 s. tddlog’s speed-up over a system is the ratio of their total times on the instances

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: both answer, together with the instances only one of them answers: tddlog’s failures counted at its time limit,

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: and the other system’s timeouts counted at the limit where that lower bound is at least the speed-up measured on

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: the instances both answer; with fewer than 20 instances both answer, there are too few in common for one. The

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: five best native systems by answers, then speed-up, have a row each; the others share one, with the least of

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: their total times and of their speed-ups. Where a type’s head names Alea.jl+tddlog, its rows’ tddlog is

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Alea.jl+tddlog: Alea.jl runs the program up to the Boolean circuit it builds, then tddlog answers from the

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: circuit, and its time is both, Alea.jl’s timed warm.
